sources.title: ITU-T G.694.1: DWDM frequency grid
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Nyquist 成形：滾降係數與頻寬
related.titleEn: Nyquist pulse shaping: roll-off and bandwidth
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學單槽上限87.5 GHz；64 GHz訊號可排入，80 GHz組需100 GHz而拒絕原配置。 spectrum_slots.csv、區間圖與保護帶證據 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 75 與變更 100 GHz、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching allocation limit87.5 GHz:64 GHz fits, while the80 GHz case needs100 GHz and rejects the original allocation. spectrum_slots.csv, interval plot and guard-band evidence Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 75 and changed 100 GHz, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學B不超75 GHz；0.10通過、0.25不通過；實際濾波尾端仍須額外量測。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching bandwidth must not exceed75 GHz:0.10 passes and0.25 fails; real filter tails require separate measurement.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成訊號占用64 GHz、每側保護5 GHz；變更占用80 GHz，保護帶不變。 名義式 ceil((64+2*5)/12.5)*12.5 = 75 GHz；變更式 ceil((80+2*5)/12.5)*12.5 = 100 GHz。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以12.5 GHz小格畫區間並數格，檢查相鄰頻槽邊界無重疊；空餘頻寬不能忽略取整。
合成符號率64 GBd；滾降α由0.10改0.25；比較既定75 GHz頻槽。 名義式 (1+0.1)*64 = 70.4 GHz；變更式 (1+0.25)*64 = 80 GHz。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 由頻寬反算α；繪頻譜支撐區間與頻槽，不用FFT尖峰的位置代替整體占用頻寬。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic occupied bandwidth64 GHz and5 GHz guard on each side; change occupied bandwidth to80 GHz. Nominal ceil((64+2*5)/12.5)*12.5 = 75 GHz; changed ceil((80+2*5)/12.5)*12.5 = 100 GHz. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Draw12.5 GHz cells and count occupied intervals; check neighboring boundaries and retain rounding overhead.

Synthetic symbol rate64 GBd; change roll-off from0.10 to0.25 against a75 GHz slot. Nominal (1+0.1)*64 = 70.4 GHz; changed (1+0.25)*64 = 80 GHz. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Recoverα from bandwidth and draw support intervals; FFT peak location is not occupied bandwidth.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GPON 分光網：分光比與功率裕度
related.titleEn: GPON splitter network: split ratio and power margin
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學單槽上限87.5 GHz；64 GHz訊號可排入，80 GHz組需100 GHz而拒絕原配置。 spectrum_slots.csv、區間圖與保護帶證據 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 75 與變更 100 GHz、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching allocation limit87.5 GHz:64 GHz fits, while the80 GHz case needs100 GHz and rejects the original allocation. spectrum_slots.csv, interval plot and guard-band evidence Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 75 and changed 100 GHz, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學剩餘裕度至少0 dB；32分光可行，64分光略負且不可藉四捨五入通過。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching remaining margin must be nonnegative:32-way split passes,64-way is slightly negative and cannot pass by rounding.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成訊號占用64 GHz、每側保護5 GHz；變更占用80 GHz，保護帶不變。 名義式 ceil((64+2*5)/12.5)*12.5 = 75 GHz；變更式 ceil((80+2*5)/12.5)*12.5 = 100 GHz。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以12.5 GHz小格畫區間並數格，檢查相鄰頻槽邊界無重疊；空餘頻寬不能忽略取整。

合成可用預算28 dB，固定纖路8 dB、超額2 dB；分光N=32改64。 名義式 28-8-2-10*log10(32) = 2.9485 dB；變更式 28-8-2-10*log10(64) = -0.0617997 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以功率均分為1/N再轉dB核對；逐支路列不平衡損耗，不能把平均裕度當最差支路。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic occupied bandwidth64 GHz and5 GHz guard on each side; change occupied bandwidth to80 GHz. Nominal ceil((64+2*5)/12.5)*12.5 = 75 GHz; changed ceil((80+2*5)/12.5)*12.5 = 100 GHz. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Draw12.5 GHz cells and count occupied intervals; check neighboring boundaries and retain rounding overhead.

Synthetic allowance28 dB, fixed path8 dB and excess2 dB; change split ratio from32 to64. Nominal 28-8-2-10*log10(32) = 2.9485 dB; changed 28-8-2-10*log10(64) = -0.0617997 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Divide power byN and convert to dB; retain per-branch imbalance instead of using mean margin as the worst branch.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
